text:
Olivia: Quick sync — Friday hands-on lab: registration + Zoom + recording + captions. Need single runbook + owners for clip handoff. Who's on point for reg page copy and who owns post-event clips? @Leah @Raj

Raj: I can own reg page copy & CTAs. Quick ask: do we want email-only or GDPR consent checkbox for EU regs? also need confirmation on timezone dropdown default.

Leah: I'll own post-event clip ownership + nurture path. Plan: 3 clips (highlight, demo, CTA). Tag leads by engagement: attended, q&a, registered-no-show. Can we add a hidden utm=lab23 param?

Sam: I'll handle Zoom settings + recording. Plan: cloud record (mp4 + transcript), local fallback script on NUC if cloud fails. Need to enable 'recording disclaimer' and SRT export for captions. Also set 'Host video on' = On. Zoom settings snippet:
```
recording: cloud
auto_record: true
save_chat: true
srt: true
```
Also will capture separate audio tracks.

ZoomBot: Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abc123 — Passcode: lab2023 — cloud recording ON

Olivia: OK owners: Raj (reg page), Sam (zoom + recording), Leah (clips + nurture). I'll own runbook doc and send to CS for replay. Deliverables before Thurs EOD: reg page draft, zoom config confirmed, recording test. @Sam can you validate SRT capture by Wed?

Sam: Yes, will run a test Wed 10am PT. I'll post test recording link in this thread.

Leah: :thumbsup: For nurture — can we get CSV with timestamps of when clips were watched? If not, we can use attended + length watched from recording analytics.

Raj: Reg page: short form with email, company, job role, timezone, check consent box. CTA text options: 'Join hands-on lab' vs 'Reserve my seat' — will A/B.

Olivia: Nice. For postflow: auto-send replay 1hr after event, 3-day digest with clips, 2-week follow-up with benchmark whitepaper. Who can own the 1hr replay email copy?

Leah: I can draft 1hr + 3-day emails.

Olivia: Perfect. I'll update runbook and tag owners. Quick checklist in runbook (copy -> zoom -> test -> record -> export srt -> clips -> email):
```
- Reg page live
- Zoom meeting created
- Recording/test passed
- Captions/SRT exported
- Clips ingested to CMS
- Email sequence scheduled
```
Closing notes: add short note about privacy (EU consent) and where to store raw recordings (secure bucket).

Sam: Uploading test after Wed run. Ping me if you want me to set up local NUC fallback.

Olivia: Thanks team :rocket:
